purpose: Voyager provides a Promise-first, outbound Discord webhook client.
description: Voyager provides a Promise-first, outbound Discord webhook client.

WebhookClient.luau.description: Sends serialized Discord webhook payloads through a bounded, rate-limit-aware Promise queue. Public entry points include `WebhookClient.new`, `WebhookClient.SendMessageAsync`, `WebhookClient.SendMessageInThreadAsync`, `WebhookClient.EditMessageAsync`, `WebhookClient.EditMessageInThreadAsync`, `WebhookClient.DeleteMessageAsync`, `WebhookClient.DeleteMessageInThreadAsync`, `WebhookClient.Destroy`.

WebhookTypes.luau.description: Defines typed outbound webhook payloads and responses.

WebhookUtils.luau.description: Validates and serializes outbound Discord webhook payloads. Public entry points include `isHttpUrl`, `isHttpsUrl`, `validateEmbed`, `getEmbedCharacterCount`, `serializeEmbed`, `WebhookUtils.validateMessageOptions`, `WebhookUtils.serializeMessage`, `WebhookUtils.resolveBaseUrl`.

init.luau.description: Provides the Promise-first outbound webhook client and payload utilities.
